name: recoverly
description: Recoverly — failed payment recovery agent for CreateOS x Stripe hackathon. NL question -> plan -> generated Python -> CreateOS Sandbox -> validated ranked queue.

paragraphs: Explainable failed-payment recovery for small subscription businesses. Recoverly turns a failed-payment export into a prioritized recovery queue. For each failed payment it says what failed, how much revenue is at risk, and the safest next step, and it drafts a customer message that a human must approve. The analysis is performed by code the agent writes at request time and runs inside a CreateOS Sandbox.
Built for the CreateOS x Stripe "Build Agents That Run Code" hackathon.
